locus: 16 July Carmel Marian Introit, printed p. 656, artifact p. 770, extracted p. 1, right column; normalized text physical line 1. Corroborating 7 October Rosary Introit: printed p. 731, artifact p. 845, extracted p. 2.
rights_basis: The complete bounded Gaudeamus Introit wording of the Tours Mame 1922 printing is independently public domain in the United States by publication date. No Reginae addition, conditional Paschal Alleluia or revised Psalm 44 rendering is supplied in this historical transcription.
text: Gaudeamus omnes in Domino, diem festum celebrantes sub honore beatae Mariae Virginis: de cujus solemnitate gaudent Angeli, et collaudant Filium Dei. Ps. 44, 2 Eructavit cor meum verbum bonum: dico ego opera mea regi. V. Gloria Patri.
